title: Predicted hidden 'anticamera' linking the north corridor to the Grand Gallery and Big Void
summary: Filippo tells of Predicted hidden 'anticamera' linking the north corridor to the Grand Gallery and Big Void, about an unknown time at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And that chamber goes directly to the Grand Gallery.

plain: A researcher named Filippo, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels in 2026, describes a hidden small room, an "anticamera" or antechamber, that he predicts lies inside the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt. He says this room connects a corridor on the pyramid's north side to the Grand Gallery, the pyramid's tall sloping inner passage, and to the Big Void, a large empty space found inside the pyramid by earlier scans. In his words, "that chamber goes directly to the Grand Gallery," which, if true, would mean the pyramid's known spaces are linked by rooms no one has yet entered.
